name: health_intervention_reconcile_lq377_20261107
comment: /v3 showed 'unrecovered=1' hours after the pipeline recovered: claude_interventions 24557 (failed,
14:01:30 ET) was never revisited after 24558 verified the same component clear at 14:06:46 ET, and the
Health Hub feed lists interventions for 7 days. Pins the reconciliation sweep: supersede a failed or
investigating row only when a LATER row for the SAME component is fixed, keep resolved_at at that later
fix so the feed does not re-sort, never re-close a row another pass already closed, write nothing on a
dry run, and never let a reconciliation error stop the escalation pass. Also pins the wiring (the sweep
runs BEFORE process_queue's empty-queue early return, the only state the handler is in once a condition
clears) and the feed's annotation of a superseded row. Hermetic: fake connections, stubbed query, tmp
queue paths. The two host_state checks are a read-only SELECT over the live schema — the candidate
predicate and the UPDATE's own SET expressions — never an UPDATE.
